title: HR policy: Annual leave
text: Staff accrue 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays. Requests go through your line manager at least two weeks ahead.

title: HR policy: Sick pay
text: Company sick pay covers your full pay for the first 20 working days in a rolling year, then statutory sick pay applies.

title: HR policy: Expenses
text: Submit expenses within 30 days with a receipt. Travel is reimbursed at standard rates. Alcohol is not reimbursable.

title: HR policy: Remote working
text: Remote and hybrid staff attend the office at least two days a week. The company provides home working equipment on request.

title: HR policy: Probation
text: New starters serve a six month probation with a review at three and six months.

title: HR policy: Grievance
text: Raise a grievance in writing to HR. You may be accompanied at any hearing by a colleague or union representative.

title: HR policy: Notice periods
text: Notice is one month for team members and three months for team leads and above.

title: HR policy: Data protection
text: Personal data is processed under UK GDPR. Payroll and contract records are restricted to the relevant department.

title: HR policy: Pension
text: The company adds 5 percent to your workplace pension each month. You can pay in more yourself at any time.

title: HR policy: Parental leave
text: Parental leave gives eligible staff enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption pay for the first 12 weeks.

title: HR policy: Health and safety
text: Report hazards to facilities. Display screen assessments are offered to all desk based staff.

title: HR policy: Code of conduct
text: Treat colleagues with respect. Bullying, harassment and discrimination are disciplinary matters.
